title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Contents Amount Sworn on a Proof of Loss
content:
The contents amount sworn on a contents proof of loss under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is worked out on the policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report, for that claim's date of loss, from the contents loss at actual cash value on the claim's FINAL adjuster report.

## Formal clause

The contents value ceiling is the contents limit, the contents deductible subtracted is the one shown on the policy, and no contents amount is treated as already sworn on the claim or under a duplicate claim number. The working applies its steps in this order: the contents value ceiling first, then the deductible, then the contents limit, then what is already sworn. The contents loss is held to the contents value ceiling, the contents deductible is then subtracted, the remainder is held between zero and the contents limit, and the contents amount already sworn on the claim and the contents amount already sworn under a duplicate claim number are subtracted, the amount sworn never going below zero. Every amount in the contents working is rounded half-up to the cent.

**Scope of this settlement.** For a contents amount sworn on a contents proof of loss, and only for such an amount, the contents loss at actual cash value is first held to the contents value ceiling, then the contents deductible is subtracted, the remainder is never below zero and never above the contents limit, and it covers only the property the tier's contents owner basis describes; every other contents settlement remains at actual cash value less the contents deductible, never below zero, capped at the contents limit.

## The steps as a table

| Step | Operation | Bound |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | contents loss at actual cash value, held to the contents value ceiling | the lower of the two |
| 2 | less the contents deductible | — |
| 3 | held between zero and the contents limit | 0 to the limit |
| 4 | less the contents amount already sworn on the claim and under a duplicate claim number | never below zero |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Contents limit 100,000; contents loss on the FINAL report 130,000.00; contents deductible on the policy 5,000.
- Held to the ceiling (the contents limit): 100,000.00.
- Less the deductible: 95,000.00.
- Within zero and the limit: 95,000.00.
- Nothing already sworn: the amount sworn is 95,000.00.

With a contents loss of 4,000.00 and the same deductible the remainder is held at zero, and nothing is sworn.
